topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I can't shake the chill that settled in when I unearthed the box. It wasn't small, too heavy for my hands to hold easily, and the metal seemed oddly familiar, though I couldn't place why. The lid was sealed tight, and when I pried it open, the contents were more unsettling than anything. Old photographs, but not of people I recognized. A diary with faded pages, words that spoke of times I couldn’t remember living. It’s been hours, and I keep thinking about who might have buried this, why, and what else might be hidden just under the surface of my quiet life.
